candidates.title: EU schafft Blaupause für vertrauenswürdige KI in der ganzen Welt
candidates.excerpt: European Parliament members approved the AI Act by 523 votes to 46, with 49 abstentions. The measure regulates AI according to risk. Formal Council endorsement was still required.

candidates.title: Lawmakers approve AI Act with overwhelming majority
candidates.excerpt: The European Parliament voted overwhelmingly for rules imposing obligations on AI systems according to their risks. The tally was 523 in favour, 46 against and 49 abstentions.

candidates.title: FDA Converts Novel Alzheimer’s Disease Treatment to Traditional Approval
candidates.excerpt: FDA converted Leqembi from accelerated to traditional approval after a confirmatory study demonstrated clinical benefit for Alzheimer’s disease. The agency had previously cleared the treatment through the accelerated pathway.

candidates.title: FDA approves first drug to slow Alzheimer's progression
candidates.excerpt: Leqembi received full FDA approval, opening a path to broader insurance coverage.

candidates.title: Nintendo announces Nintendo Switch OLED Model with a vibrant 7-inch OLED screen launching Oct 8
candidates.excerpt: Nintendo announced a Switch model with a larger OLED display, more storage and an improved stand. The company scheduled October 8 availability at a suggested $349.99 price.

candidates.title: Nintendo Switch OLED coming this October
candidates.excerpt: Nintendo unveiled an OLED Switch with expanded storage and an adjustable stand.

candidates.title: Artificial intelligence (AI) act: Council gives final green light to the first worldwide rules on AI
candidates.excerpt: The Council formally approved the AI Act, including risk-based obligations and prohibited uses. Signature and official publication were the next steps before entry into force.

candidates.title: FDA Grants Accelerated Approval for Alzheimer’s Disease Treatment
candidates.excerpt: FDA approved Leqembi through its accelerated approval pathway for Alzheimer’s disease. The announcement described a medicine targeting the disease’s underlying biology.

candidates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
candidates.excerpt: The FOMC reduced its federal funds target by half a percentage point to 4.75–5 percent. Policymakers cited progress against inflation and a changing balance of employment and inflation risks. One voter preferred a smaller cut.

candidates.title: Fed cuts interest rates 0.5 point, noting slowing job market
candidates.excerpt: The September decision lowered the target to 4.75–5 percent amid employment concerns.

candidates.title: NASA’s Europa Clipper Mission Launches From Kennedy Space Center (Highlights)
candidates.excerpt: Europa Clipper departed Florida on October 14 aboard a Falcon Heavy. Its mission will investigate whether Jupiter’s icy moon offers conditions compatible with life, using instruments during repeated flybys after reaching Jupiter in 2030.

candidates.title: ‘Europa Clipper’: la NASA lanza la mayor nave interplanetaria para buscar rastros de vida en la luna de Júpiter
candidates.excerpt: NASA launched Europa Clipper toward Jupiter’s moon Europa. The spacecraft will examine an icy ocean world and assess its potential to sustain life.

candidates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
candidates.excerpt: At its November meeting, the FOMC lowered the federal funds target by a quarter percentage point to 4.5–4.75 percent. It continued reducing securities holdings and said employment and inflation risks were roughly balanced.

candidates.title: Apple introduces HomePod mini in midnight
candidates.excerpt: Apple announced a midnight color option for its existing HomePod mini smart speaker. The new finish uses recycled mesh and was scheduled for availability on July 17, alongside the product’s other colors.

candidates.title: Apple introduces the new HomePod with breakthrough sound and intelligence
